name: UniSQ Residential School Bursary
summary: Small bursary for lower-income domestic UniSQ students who must attend a mandatory residential school.
key: Each bursary will have a maximum value of $250 to be paid in one instalment.
who: Enrolled in a course with a mandatory residential school
how: Apply through the UniSQ Scholarship Application Management System
catches: All 2026 rounds have closed (Trimester 3 closed 6 October 2026); check the page for 2027 rounds
